balloon.definition: A flexible bag inflated with air or gas, used as a party decoration here.

banner.definition: Long strip of cloth or paper used for decoration or advertising.

streamer.definition: A long narrow strip of paper or fabric used as a hanging decoration.

confetti.definition: Small pieces or streamers of colored paper that are thrown around on festive occasions (as at a wedding).

party-hat.definition: A decorative hat, often made of paper, worn at a celebration.
party-hat.exampleUsage: Each guest received a colorful party hat.

tablecloth.definition: A piece of cloth spread over a table for decoration or protection.

centerpiece.definition: A decorative arrangement placed in the middle of a table.

garland.definition: A string of decorations hung across a room or around an object.

pinata.definition: Plaything consisting of a container filled with toys and candy.

bunting.definition: A row of small decorative flags attached to a string.

cake.definition: A sweet baked food that may be decorated or filled.

cupcake.definition: A small individual cake with icing.

ice-cream.definition: A frozen sweet dessert, often made with milk or cream.

pizza.definition: Italian open pie made of thin bread dough spread with a spiced mixture of e.g. tomato sauce and cheese.

candy.definition: A rich sweet made of flavored sugar and often combined with fruit or nuts.

popcorn.definition: Small pieces of corn heated until they burst into white pieces.

juice-box.definition: A small sealed carton containing a single serving of juice.
juice-box.exampleUsage: An adult guest chose a juice box from the table.

lemonade.definition: A cold sweet drink made with lemons, water, and sugar.

fruit.definition: Edible plant produce such as apples, oranges and bananas in this food context.

chips.definition: Thin crisp potato slices in American English, called crisps in British English; British chips can mean thicker fried strips.

musical-chairs.definition: A game in which players try to sit when music stops, with fewer chairs than players.

pin-the-tail.definition: A party game in which a blindfolded player tries to place a paper tail on a picture.
pin-the-tail.exampleUsage: The adult organizer explained pin the tail as a game of placing a paper tail on a picture.

treasure-hunt.definition: A game in which players follow a sequence of clues to locate objects that have been hidden.

face-painting.definition: Decorating a face with cosmetic colors for entertainment or performance.

balloon-animals.definition: Animal shapes made by twisting long inflatable balloons.
balloon-animals.exampleUsage: The entertainer made balloon animals for the guests.

relay-race.definition: A team race divides the course into sections, with each runner completing one before handing an object to a teammate.

karaoke.definition: Singing with recorded instrumental accompaniment, often while following displayed lyrics.

dance.definition: Movement of the body to music, or the activity of doing so.

limbo.definition: A dance or game involving passing under a horizontal bar while leaning backward.

tag.definition: A chasing game in which one player tries to touch another, who then becomes the chaser.

present.definition: Something given to another person as a gift.

wrapping-paper.definition: Decorated paper is placed around a gift or other item to protect it and make it ready for presentation or sale.

bow.definition: A decorative knot with two loops, often made from ribbon.

gift-bag.definition: A decorative bag used to hold a present or small items given to guests.
gift-bag.exampleUsage: Nadia brought a present in a gift bag.

card.definition: A rectangular piece of stiff paper used to send messages (may have printed greetings or pictures).

ribbon.definition: A long narrow strip of fabric used for tying or decoration.

tissue-paper.definition: Very thin soft paper used for wrapping, crafts, or decoration.
tissue-paper.exampleUsage: The gift bag was filled with bright tissue paper.

surprise.definition: The astonishment you feel when something totally unexpected happens to you.

thank-you-note.definition: A brief message written to show appreciation for a gift, service, or assistance.

napkin.definition: A small piece of table linen that is used to wipe the mouth and to cover the lap in order to protect clothing.

lighter.definition: A small tool that produces a flame for lighting things.
lighter.exampleUsage: The adult host kept the lighter separate from the unlit birthday candle.

party-horn.definition: A small party noisemaker that produces a loud sound when blown.
party-horn.exampleUsage: The host set the party horn aside because the guests preferred gentle music.

whistle.definition: A small object blown to make a loud signal.

glow-stick.definition: A sealed plastic tube that produces light through a chemical reaction when activated.
glow-stick.exampleUsage: The glow stick shone brightly in the dark room.

sticker.definition: A small piece of paper or plastic with an adhesive back, used as a decoration or label.

birthday-child.definition: The child whose birthday is being celebrated.
birthday-child.exampleUsage: The birthday child stood beside the cake.

guest.definition: A person invited to a party or event.

clown.definition: A performer who wears a funny costume and tries to make people laugh.

magician.definition: A performer who uses tricks and illusions to entertain people.

wish.definition: The particular preference that you have.

blow-candles.definition: To blow air toward birthday candles so their flames go out.
blow-candles.exampleUsage: The birthday child blew out the candles.

open-gifts.definition: To remove wrapping or packaging from presents in order to see what is inside.
open-gifts.exampleUsage: She opened the gifts after the cake was served.

group-photo.definition: A photograph showing several people together.
group-photo.exampleUsage: Everyone gathered for a group photo.

sing.definition: To make musical sounds with the voice.

celebrate.definition: To mark a special occasion with enjoyable or meaningful activities.

plate.definition: A flat dish from which food is eaten.

cup.definition: A small open container used for drinking, often with a handle.

fork.definition: An eating utensil with pointed prongs.

candle.definition: Wax surrounding a wick that can burn to provide light.
